title: Solve linear equations and find where two lines meet

slides.title: Where do the wires cross?
slides.text: Two wires leave the same wall of pylons. Wire A starts low and climbs fast, and wire B starts high and comes down. Tally must build one platform that both wires reach, so it has to stand at exactly the right point.

slides.title: One point on both lines
slides.text: Wire A is y = 2x + 1 and wire B is y = −x + 7. The point where they cross is on both lines, so it makes both rules true. Here that point is (2, 5): 2 × 2 + 1 = 5 and −2 + 7 = 5.

visual.label: Two lines that cross at one point

focus.cue: Wire A climbs 2 for each step across.
Wire B drops 1 for each step across.
They cross at (2, 5), the one point on both.

slides.title: Set the rules equal
slides.text: At the crossing the two heights are equal, so write 2x + 1 = −x + 7 and solve it. Collect the x terms on one side and the plain numbers on the other. Then use either rule to find y.

slides.title: No crossing, or every point
slides.text: Lines with the same slope and different starts are parallel. The equation 2x + 1 = 2x + 4 leads to 1 = 4, which is never true, so there is no solution. When both rules make the same line, such as 2x + 4 and 2(x + 2), every point is a solution.

visual.label: Two parallel lines that never cross

focus.cue: This line starts at 1 and climbs 2 each step.
This one starts at 4 and climbs 2 as well: always 3 higher.

slides.title: Brackets and both sides
slides.text: Some equations need tidying first. In 2(x + 1) = x + 5, multiply out the brackets to get 2x + 2 = x + 5. Subtract x from both sides and then subtract 2, which leaves x = 3. Put it back to check: 2 × 4 = 8 and 3 + 5 = 8.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: Four words for equations and crossing lines.

words.means: an equation whose letters have no powers, such as 2x + 1 = 7
a value, or a pair of values, that makes every equation true
two or more equations that must be true at the same time
lines with the same slope that never meet

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Sky Lines at Meeting Point. Find how far across two wires are level, then put the platform where they cross. Watch for wires that never meet.
slides.alt: Sky Lines on a phone: a grid with the starts of wire A and wire B, the equation 2x + 1 = x + 4 and a stepper to set how far across.
